thread:
Alex (support): Hey team — ticket from Jordan at Novaware. Customer finished signup + SSO but the Console shows NO API keys for their new project. Ticket INC-4321. Project name 'novaware-prod'.
Jordan (acct): Yep, they completed the invite flow. Console UI: "No API keys available" and the API returns an empty array. They need a key to start calls. Region: us-west-2.
Ishan (support): Can you paste project id / org id so we can repro? Also any timestamp from their retry?
Alex (support): proj id: proj-nova-987, org-id: org-23. Their retry was ~2026-11-03T15:04:10Z. Onboard webhook responded 200 but payload had "key_count": 0.
Maria (sre): Weird. The onboard worker should auto-provision a key. I'll tail the worker log now.
Maria (sre): log excerpt:
```
2026-11-03T15:04:09Z INFO onboard: received event for proj-nova-987
2026-11-03T15:04:10Z ERROR onboard_worker: identity_sync failed: org not found (org-23)
2026-11-03T15:04:10Z INFO onboard_worker: acked event, no retry scheduled
```
Alex (support): ah. So the worker acked with error and didn't retry. Customer sees nothing.
Ishan (support): Can you run the admin reconcile? `adminctl onboard:reconcile proj-nova-987` — that should attempt to re-mint.
SRE-Bot: Command received: adminctl onboard:reconcile proj-nova-987. Job queued (jid=onb-7742).
SRE-Bot: Job onb-7742 completed: success. Created 1 API key (id=key-45a9).
Jordan (acct): I pasted key to the customer and they confirmed API calls are succeeding now (200, latency normal).
Alex (support): Thanks. Root cause looks like an ordering/race condition: SSO created project row before identity index was fully synced, onboard worker saw missing org mapping and acked. Need reliable retry or fail-open to requeue.
Maria (sre): Filing ENGINFRA-9876: onboard-worker should not ack on transient identity lookup failures. Proposed fix: add exponential backoff + idempotent reconcile and alert when `key_count == 0` for >10m after onboarding.
Ishan (support): Workaround documented: run `adminctl onboard:reconcile <project>` or go to Console > Projects > [project] > Actions > Reconcile keys. I'll add KB article and send to Jordan.
Alex (support): I've updated support ticket INC-4321 with steps and the workaround. Customer impact: single new customer blocked for ~12 minutes. No billing impact.
Jordan (acct): Customer appreciated the quick fix. Please notify sales to pause any internal escalation.
Maria (sre): Added monitoring: onboard_worker errors where error contains "org not found" create a pager only if it persists 3 times within 15m.
Alex (support): Closing thread. Follow-ups: ENGINFRA-9876 (fix), KB-1234 (how to reconcile), and support runbook update. :memo: :white_check_mark:
Jordan (acct): Thanks all — great cross-team response. :tada:
